description: List the saved filters (saved searches) the user created in the Fundz web app: name and what it filters on (series, investors, locations, industries, amount, company size, keywords). Use a saved filter's name as the `saved_filter` argument of search_funding_rounds, search_executive_changes or search_acquisitions (matching its type) to run that exact search. Requires signing in (not available with a plain API key).
name: get_saved_filters
title: Get saved filters
